title: AI for Web Accessibility – Smarter Web Accessibility
description: AI for Web Accessibility automates accessibility checks, ensures compliance, and builds fully inclusive websites. Enhance usability and get started today.
body:
# AI Powered Digital Accessibility

### AI accelerators that help teams improve digital accessibility faster across websites and documents. We deploy solutions that identify barriers, prioritize fixes, and support inclusive experiences at scale, tailored to your environment.

### Accessibility Delivery Path

A simple rollout that detects barriers, speeds remediation, and keeps web and documents accessible as content evolves.

### AEM Accessibility Audit

AI-assisted document remediation accelerator that identifies accessibility gaps in PDFs and files, supports faster remediation, and helps teams publish accessible documents with consistent structure, readability, and usability.

### How It Works

A simple, deployment-ready process to improve accessibility with speed, clarity, and measurable progress.

- 1. Barrier DetectionScan assets, flag blockers, and prioritize fixes quickly.
- 2. Smart RemediationApply guided fixes using AI workflows and templates.
- 3. Ongoing ValidationVerify updates, track progress, and prevent regressions.
- 4. Continuous MonitoringTrack changes, and maintain accessibility.
